# Knowledge Base (for RAG)

Drop `.md` / `.txt` files in this folder and the Chat tab can retrieve relevant snippets.

Tips:
- Keep files short and structured (headings + bullet points).
- Prefer writing your own notes/summaries and linking to sources, instead of copying full articles.
- If you add/modify files, use the app sidebar “Clear cache” button to rebuild the index.

## Autogenerated news summaries (optional)

If you want “fresh” Premier League news without maintaining cards manually, you can run:

- `NEWS_FEEDS="https://...rss.xml,https://...atom.xml" python3 scripts/ingest_news.py`

This will:
- Pull new items from RSS/Atom feeds
- (Optionally) fetch the full article page
- Summarize with the LLM (uses your `OPENAI_API_KEY`)
- Write Markdown into `kb/auto/news/` (gitignored) so the Chat tab can retrieve it

Notes:
- Use `--rss-only` if a site blocks HTML fetching (it will summarize the RSS description only).
- Use the Streamlit sidebar “Clear cache” after ingesting so the index rebuilds.
